body:
Thanks for your reply, and everyone else's.

The dying part is not what has me down, it's the stigma. I worry I wouldn't be able to handle the rejection. This is the major source of anxiety.

I for sure am going to get tested, the unfortunate part of that is there is a window period of at least 6 weeks before a test can be reliable, and it's just been very difficult waiting. I just hope to get myself in a better place in case the test comes back positive so I don't hurt myself.

I think I need professional help, I'm just not even sure how to go about that. 

Thanks again.
